notes.title: First DLC-collection
notes.notes:
[i]Hello everyone! While the second episode is being forged in the furnaces of our studio, we want to brighten your wait with the first set of promised additions.[/i]

[h1][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3423260/]Original Soundtrack[/url][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44603423/e1fc008e41b2bcf1210eda3e221ca72e0b6cb03f.jpg[/img]
Tracks by Pazetic Ocean, Leety, and Between August and December (special guest!).
The soundtrack is updated during the game's development. Currently, it includes tracks from the first episode of the visual novel.
All proceeds will be distributed among the music authors.
Please note: the price may increase as updates are released.

[h1][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3487290/]Free music Collection[/url][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44603423/6d54d9f95903efd40b2be037a3b8d472242d6693.jpg[/img]
A free selection of music used in the visual novel. The collection is updated as the game progresses.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3462090/][h1]Audio Drama №1[/h1][/url]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44603423/63c878356f40bb2527c2f0799fa2f880f27ead44.jpg[/img]
A bonus New Year's story that takes place before the events of the game. Available only in Russian (english subtitles are available)!
Includes both audio and video versions. Duration: 33 minutes.


[url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/50119]A bundle with all of the above is also available at an additional discount.[/url]

notes.title: Happy New Years and Merry Christmas!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44603423/7056d0a832fc314a1983bfac9d506f9c6be57018.jpg[/img]
Hello everyone!
The New Year’s chimes are getting closer, and that means it’s time to send our best wishes to our followers!

Let’s be original and skip the usual greetings – instead, here’s our roadmap for 2025:

Release of the OST. It’s already finished, but the holiday special was slightly delayed due to an unexpected cold from Stasya (don’t be like Stasya, dress warmly!).

Release of the art book for the first episode. It will include illustrations from the game as well as various working materials, including some never-before-published content.

Game updates. We’re currently reworking the technical side of the visual novel, including sprites, the interface, additional menus, and other details. We’ve also tested support for mods and the workshop.

And the best part: the release of the second episode! We’ve expanded it to include 8 days for each route, which has extended development time. However, work is progressing steadily, and the update will be released as soon as everything is ready. Even now, the amount of new content is impressive, and there are still several event-packed days ahead.


Thank you for staying with us; your support means a lot to us and motivates us to keep working on the project. We, in turn, will do everything possible to bring you the continuation of your favorite characters’ adventures as soon as we can.

We won’t spoil all the details, but we can promise one thing: it’s going to be exciting!

Happy New Year, friends!
Best wishes,
The Development Team

notes.title: CEIBA: Release!
notes.notes:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/40611651/49b03560bf92e49b37ca2953b75ab5ca2e5e748e.png[/img]
Enjoy the atmosphere of unconventional science fiction together with the crew of the research station "Ailanthus"! The mysterious plant world of "Ailanthus" hides many secrets, some of which you, in the role of the young laboratory technician Ein, will be able to solve. In this you will be helped - or maybe hindered - by the other crew members: the commander of the biolab Yoli, the chief engineer Sabu and the charming but uncommunicative Miri, who carries the heavy burden of a communications engineer. Why heavy? There are specific reasons, which Ein is about to find out. Reasons that can shake not only the small cozy world of the lab technician, but also the whole "Ailanthus".

CEIBA visual novel is not only a fascinating story, but also a wonderful work of artists, who tried to convey even in small details the plant world of "Ailanthus", contrasting sharply with the gloomy planet somewhere under the clouds. The music design is not lagging behind, which intensifies the atmosphere of the unknown. And the reader familiar with the Wirion studio's previous project "Athanasy" may find suspicious details linking these novels.

The authors of Athanasy, warmly accepted by the community, once again show a high level of quality. This time the main theme of the novel is symbiosis, and also... However, you can find out everything yourself, can't you?

You can buy the novel here: [url=]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2398940/Ceiba/[/url]
Please leave reviews and share your experiences!
